# Repto

> Repto is a workout tracker and gym log for iPhone, Apple Watch and Android, with a built-in AI coach. You log sets in seconds and follow rest timers on the Lock Screen, in the Dynamic Island or on your wrist. It comes with 789+ illustrated exercises, 41 ready-made programs and AI meal plans. The core app is free. Repto Pro adds the AI features and starts with a 14-day free trial.

Website: https://reptofit.com/ (English) · https://reptofit.com/vi/ (Vietnamese)
Download: [App Store](https://apps.apple.com/app/repto-workout-tracker/id6761402067) · [Google Play](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=app.repto.android)
Platforms: iOS 17+, standalone Apple Watch app, Android
Languages: English, Vietnamese, Simplified Chinese, Japanese, Korean, German, French, Spanish
Contact: support@reptofit.com · https://www.facebook.com/reptoapp/

## Key features

- Workout logging: tick a set, rest, repeat. Shows what you lifted last time and suggests the next weight (progressive overload, e.g. 60 kg → 62.5 kg).
- Tracking modes: reps × weight, reps only, duration, cardio/distance; kg or lbs. Unlimited custom exercises, muscle heatmap.
- Exercise library: 789+ illustrated exercises, 668 demo videos.
- Programs: 41 ready-made programs (Push/Pull/Legs, Upper/Lower, Full Body Beginner, 5x5 Strength, Bro Split, Dumbbell Full Body, Bodyweight Starter, Home Minimal Setup, 8-Week Squat/Bench/Deadlift PR, Glute Builder, 30-Day Shred, Posture Builder and more), filterable by goal, level, equipment, muscle group and sport. Single-workout templates and custom programs.
- Onboarding: answer goal, sex, level, schedule, equipment, height and weight, and AI builds a program in about 30 seconds.
- Rest timer everywhere: Live Activities and Dynamic Island on iPhone, Live Update on Android 16, meal plan widget.
- Apple Watch: works without the iPhone, with live heart rate, rest timer, workout summary and Watch ↔ iPhone sync.
- Repto Coach (AI, Pro): AI program generation, weekly review, "ask your data" chat, explanations of charts, AI single workouts, insight feed.
- AI meal plan (Pro): automatic calories and macros, weekly menus, dish swaps. Building your own meals is free.
- Analytics: per-exercise stats and estimated 1RM, muscle-group volume, streaks, PR badges, weekly and monthly training summaries.
- Body composition scan: read InBody, ACCUNIQ or Tanita result sheets with AI.
- Apple Health: two-way sync (writes workouts and body composition; reads weight, sleep, body fat, resting heart rate, calories, heart rate).
- Sharing: share a workout with a 6-character code, a reptofit.com link or a .reptoplan file; CSV export; 6 post-workout poster cards.
- Also: nearby gyms and parks map, sync across devices (Sign in with Apple or Google), light/dark theme, custom sounds and haptics.

## Pricing

- Free ($0, forever): unlimited programs and history, rest timers, Live Activities, Apple Watch, Apple Health sync, share codes/links/CSV export, 1 AI-generated program, 1 body scan.
- Repto Pro: $1.29/month or $11.99/year (save ~22%). Both start with a 14-day free trial, and you can cancel before it ends without being charged. Lifetime: $29.99 one-time (no trial).
- Pro includes: Repto Coach (review, chat, explain, insights), unlimited AI-generated programs, AI meal plans, full charts (3M/6M/1Y/All), all 6 share cards with the logo hidden, unlimited body scans.
- Subscriptions are billed and managed by Apple or Google. Refunds go through the store.

## Privacy

- Health data is processed on the device and is never sold or used for advertising.
- The AI Coach uses Anthropic's Claude API. Only goals, workout summaries and aggregate metrics are sent, never raw health records, and Anthropic does not train on this data.
